release: Quality Profile UI & Update Version Coherency
name: Quality Profile UI & Update Version Coherency
changes: Reworks the Quality Profile editor into a dedicated fixed-header / scroll-body / fixed-footer dialog with consistent gutters, aligned controls, uniform field heights, clearer section spacing and responsive layouts.
Removes the stale hard-coded v3.6.62 text from About & Updates and reports the installed version dynamically.
Separates installed, runtime and UI versions in the update center so version mismatches are shown explicitly instead of being misrepresented as an available update.
Uses the installed version.txt value as the backend update-comparison authority and invalidates update-feed cache entries created by a different installed version.
Adds a frontend same-version safety check so the currently installed/UI release can never be offered as an upgrade even if an older runtime or stale feed result reports otherwise.
Recomputes cached-feed update availability against the current installed version on fallback after a feed error.
Carries the v3.6.81 Automation Intelligence & Quality Profiles behavior and the v3.6.82 canonical release pipeline forward unchanged outside these targeted fixes.

Preserves the accepted Newsgroup Browser performance architecture, SABnzbd 5.1.2 integration, download/post-processing pipeline, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 and Defender-clean yEnc pipeline.
regression_guards: v3.6.83 pins the reviewed server, UI, stylesheet and profile-layout payload hashes and behavior checks.
A same-version latest release must never set update_available when installed version.txt already matches that release.
An update cache created by an older installed version must not be accepted as a coherent current cache.
The About dialog must not contain any hard-coded historical NewzDeck v3.6.62 label and must expose dynamic installed/runtime version fields.
The Quality Profile modal must use dedicated scroll-body/footer layout markers and preserve all structured profile controls introduced in v3.6.81.
v3.6.81 quality upgrade semantics and monitored metadata independence remain guarded.
The canonical Source commit trigger parser/writer and source -> tag -> trigger release topology remain fail-closed.
The v3.6.78 LF/Linux yEnc source and accepted helper hash gates remain unchanged along with frozen browser admission/sampling/header/resolver constants and SABnzbd 5.1.2.
